Ollama library contains 4,500+ models (curated + community) as of May 2026, including Llama 4, Qwen3, DeepSeek R1, Gemma 4, Mistral
Properly configured Ollama deployments achieve 40-60% cost savings compared to cloud APIs while maintaining comparable performance
HuggingFace hosts 135,000 GGUF-formatted models optimized for local inference, up from 200 three years ago
Ollama typically achieves 15-20% faster inference than LocalAI for LLM workloads
A team of 5 developers can incur $3,000–$30,000 in cloud LLM API costs over a 3-month development cycle before shipping anything
